# ABC (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)

> > Australia's national public broadcaster providing news, television, radio, and digital content across the nation and internationally.

The ABC is Australia's most trusted source of independent news and information, operating multiple television channels, radio networks, and digital platforms. The organization serves audiences domestically and throughout the Asia-Pacific region through programs like ABC NEWS, 7.30, and ABC International Development initiatives.
